_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
U kurula Golf (Keki ya Kari) - Mkuruleni {player_id}.
Nchumu: U ku na skorho lowu ngana ku sungula. Hikwalaho koloni zi sungula skorho lowu fanana, zi hlanganisa ku sungula 0.
Mavuthu ya Keki: A=1, 2-10=mavuthu, J/Q=10, K=0

Nguvu (sebetela nguvu wo sungula):
- '[draw]' - Sungula ku sungula
- '[take]' - Teka ku sungula tshikani
- '[swap X Y]' - Kombisa kaki leri ku sunguriwe na sungula X (sungula) Y (koloni)
- '[discard]' - Tshika kaki leri ku sunguriwe

board.drew:
U a ku: {card}
Ku fana na u [swap X Y] or [discard] yona.
board.took: U teke: {card} eka nhulu ya thyaka. U fanele u [swap X Y] na yona (a yi nge lahliwi).
board.peeked: U a ku vona ku sungula ({row},{col}): {card}

options.final_turns: Sunguri wo mahlweni! Swivangelo swa wena: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: U fanele: [swap X Y] (a wu nge swi koti ku lahla makhadi lama nga eka xikatsa xa leswi lahliwaka)

action_desc.swapped: Mkuruleni {pid} wa kombisa {new} na {old} ku sungula ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Ntlangu wu hela hi ku hatlisa.
message.knocked: Mutlangi {pid} u tluriwile! Un'wana ni un'wana wa vatlangi lavan'wana va kuma nkarhi wun'we.
message.final_round: Mkuruleni {pid} {reason}! Vangani vambirhi va vaya na sungula yin'wana.

invalid.wrong_action: Use exactly ONE bracketed action: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], or [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Nhulu ya thyaka yi hava nchumu!
invalid.must_draw_first: U fanele ku sungula [draw], [take], [knock], or [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: A wu nge swi koti ku lahla khadi leri tekiweke eka nhulu ya makhadi lama lahliwaka. U fanele u ri cinca.
invalid.have_drawn_card: U na kaki leri ku sunguriwe. U fanele [swap X Y] or [discard] yona.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: You need a drawn card to swap.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: You need a drawn card to discard.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Sungula leri ku n'walungu. U sebetela sungula 1-{max_row}, koloni 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: A wu nge bi riqingho u nga si humesa khadi. Rhanga hi ku heta ntirho wa wena.
invalid.already_knocked: Un'wana ana se u belele xirhendzevutana lexi.
